Name: test_TC016_empty_state_display[chromium]
Description:
When badge==0 the section stays visible with no card elements in DOM.
    
    Uses ALT_COHORT (DailyStandUp_Cohort) which has 0 Today appointments,
    so this test always runs regardless of DEFAULT_COHORT seeded meetings.

Name: test_TC023_post_midnight_early_morning_indexing[chromium]
Description:
12:xx AM cards must appear at the top of their day's appointment list.

    A 12:00 AM meeting is seeded for tomorrow. This Week always includes tomorrow,
    so the midnight card appears. We verify it exists and is not the last item.

Name: test_overnight_meeting_in_today[chromium]
Description:
An 11:30 PM cross-midnight session must appear in the Today view. (covers TC019 + TC022)

    A meeting seeded at 11:30 PM tonight (60-min, ending 12:30 AM) is created at setup.
    The Today filter must include it because the session starts today.
    Falls back to scanning live 11:xx PM cards if the suite ran after 11:00 PM CDT.

Name: test_TC014_cohort_dropdown_refreshes_list[chromium]
Description: Switching the cohort dropdown refreshes the appointment list.

Name: test_TC007_accordion_collapse_expand[chromium]
Description: Chevron toggle collapses then re-expands. Section must stay visible throughout.

Name: test_TC020_scrollable_month_list[chromium]
Description: Page body must not stretch infinitely when many appointments are shown.

Name: test_TC018_long_title_truncation[chromium]
Description:
A card with a title >80 chars must not overflow its container.

    A long-title meeting is seeded in create_auth_state so this test always runs.
    We search for the seeded title by scanning each card's full text content,
    which avoids being brittle about which child element carries the title.

Name: test_TC017_loading_state_on_slow_network[chromium]
Description:
Verifies 'Loading appointments...' appears then disappears under throttled network.

    If the loading state resolves before Playwright can observe it (e.g. warm cache),
    the test still passes — we only require the final state shows no spinner.

Name: test_TC003_badge_count_matches_today_cards[chromium]
Description: <span class='count'> must equal the number of visible appointment cards.

Name: test_TC024_exact_midnight_boundary[chromium]
Description: A 12:00 AM meeting seeded for tomorrow must appear in the This Week list.

Name: test_TC008_join_card_workflow[chromium]
Description: Join button count==card count, clicking opens modal, modal content matches card.

Name: test_TC013_copy_link_functionality[chromium]
Description: Clipboard must contain a URL after clicking Copy Link in the modal.

Name: test_TC011_join_by_habitnu_meet[chromium]
Description: Join Now opens the meeting URL in a new tab.

Name: test_TC004_filter_tabs_and_badge[chromium]
Description: Badge==cards for all 3 filters; Week and Month mark active; Week>=Today.

Name: test_TC015_card_display_correctness[chromium]
Description: TC015: No Today card is a past meeting. TC021: Times are in 12-hour AM/PM format.

Name: test_TC025_badge_counts_overnight_sessions[chromium]
Description: Badge count must equal the number of visible cards (including overnight sessions).

Name: test_TC001_dashboard_renders_correctly[chromium]
Description: Section visible, badge visible, all 3 filters visible, Today filter active by default.
